        142 257 138 267 138 277   138 287 137 298 139 305
        132 305 123 305 115 305   111 294 106 284 104 274
        101 262 99 253 100 242   101 236 103 229 104 225`,
      leftArm: `113 80
        96 86 103 114 113 136   121 156 130 183 139 204
        141 210 142 214 145 218   150 220 157 216 159 211
        156 194 149 174 146 157   143 134 140 105 132 90
        127 81 119 77 113 80`,
      rightArm: `94 83
        87 95 85 113 83 137   81 154 82 170 85 182
        88 185 92 185 95 181   96 170 96 155 97 143
        99 124 104 105 102 95   101 88 99 84 94 83`,
      bodyPaint: [55,237, 65,197, 128,92,80,66, 146,203,66,46, 106,192, 86,135,32,38, 222,239, 131],
      headPaint: [101,18,135,91, 101,26,37,24, 88,59,21,18, 62,103],
      legPaint: [97,143,99,151,227,304],
      leftPaint: [104,95,155,219],
      rightPaint: [92,109,88,183],
      leftEye: [78.4,39.6,.38,.81,-10,1,1],
      rightEye: [83,39,.14,.7,-12,.9,0],
      nose: [76.4,49,.49,.82,-16,.54],
      mouth: [78.8,57,.28,.76,-15,-.35,.54],
      leftHand: [148,208,-32,.98,.88],
      rightHand: [88,180,-12,-.51,.66],
      handShapes: ['drop','rest'],
      layering: [1,0,.31,0,.55,0,0]
    }
  ];

  const fingers = {
    rest: [3,0, 7,10, 8,24, 6,25, 3,17, 3,30, 0,34, -2,24, -3,36, -6,39, -7,28, -9,39, -12,40, -12,29, -14,34, -15,33, -14,21, -9,11, -4,1],
    spread: [5,0, 8,8, 14,16, 12,19, 5,15, 7,32, 4,34, 1,24, -1,38, -4,39, -6,26, -9,35, -12,34, -11,23, -16,28, -18,26, -13,15, -8,7, -5,0],
    reach: [5,-4, 8,6, 17,13, 17,16, 7,15, 11,29, 8,31, 3,24, -1,38, -4,38, -6,25, -12,33, -15,31, -11,22, -18,27, -20,24, -14,13, -8,6, -5,-3],
    cup: [5,-3, 8,7, 12,13, 11,16, 5,15, 7,24, 5,28, 2,22, 1,30, -2,32, -3,24, -6,29, -8,29, -7,22, -11,24, -13,22, -12,15, -8,7, -5,-2],
    fold: [5,-2, 9,9, 10,15, 8,17, 5,15, 6,26, 3,28, 1,23, 1,30, -2,32, -4,24, -6,28, -8,27, -7,23, -10,24, -11,21, -10,15, -7,6, -5,-1],
    flat: [4,-3, 6,7, 8,14, 7,17, 4,15, 6,26, 5,30, 2,23, 2,32, 0,35, -2,27, -3,32, -5,31, -5,24, -7,27, -9,24, -8,14, -6,6, -4,-2],
    fist: [5,-4, 8,4, 12,8, 11,12, 7,12, 9,16, 7,19, 5,18, 4,21, 1,22, -1,20, -4,21, -6,19, -7,17, -9,16, -10,13, -9,8, -7,4, -5,-3],
    drop: [5,-3, 8,7, 12,14, 11,18, 6,15, 11,26, 8,28, 4,21, 5,33, 2,35, -1,25, -2,33, -5,33, -6,24, -9,29, -11,27, -11,17, -8,8, -5,-3]
  };

  const outlines = {
    torso: 'torso-outline',
    head: 'head-outline',
    belly: 'belly-outline',
    leftLeg: 'left-leg-outline',
    rightLeg: 'right-leg-outline',
    leftArm: 'left-arm-outline',
    rightArm: 'right-arm-outline'
  };
  const elements = Object.fromEntries(
    Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('svg [id]'), node => [node.id, node])
  );
  for (const pose of poses) {
    for (const name of Object.keys(outlines)) {
      pose[name] = pose[name].trim().split(/\s+/).map(Number);
    }
  }

  function mix(from, to, progress) {
    return from.map((value, index) => value + (to[index] - value) * progress);
  }

  function set(id, name, value) {
    elements[id].setAttribute(name, value);
  }

  function opacity(id, value) {
    set(id, 'opacity', value);
  }

  function place(id, x, y, angle, sx, sy) {
    set(id, 'transform', `translate(${x} ${y}) rotate(${angle}) scale(${sx} ${sy})`);
  }

  function linear(id, x1, y1, x2, y2) {
    set(id, 'x1', x1);
    set(id, 'y1', y1);
    set(id, 'x2', x2);
    set(id, 'y2', y2);
  }

  function radial(id, x, y, rx, ry, angle = 0) {
    set(id, 'gradientTransform', `translate(${x} ${y}) rotate(${angle}) scale(${rx} ${ry})`);
  }

  function drawEye(side, [x, y, sx, sy, angle, open, visibility]) {
    place(`eye-screen-${side}`, x, y, angle, sx, sy);
    opacity(`eye-screen-${side}`, visibility);
    set(`${side}-iris`, 'transform', `scale(1 ${.08 + .92 * open})`);
    opacity(`${side}-iris`, open);
    opacity(`${side}-lid`, 1 - open);
  }

  function drawMouth([x, y, sx, sy, angle, curve, visibility]) {
    place('mouth', x, y, angle, sx, sy);
    opacity('mouth', visibility);
    set('mouth-shadow', 'd',
      `M-11.3 -.5 C-5.4 ${curve} 5.4 ${curve} 11.1 -.8
       C8.3 ${curve + 2} 4 ${curve + 2.9} -.8 ${curve + 2.7}
       C-5.7 ${curve + 2.5} -9.4 ${curve + 1.4} -11.3 -.5Z`);
    set('mouth-line', 'd',
      `M-11 -.7 C-5 ${curve} 5 ${curve} 10.8 -1
       C7.5 ${curve + 1.3} 3.8 ${curve + 1.1} .6 ${curve + 1}
       C-4 ${curve + 1.3} -8.5 ${curve + .6} -11 .3Z`);
    set('mouth-light', 'd', `M-6.5 -.65 C-2 ${curve - .75} 3 ${curve - .75} 7 -.8`);
  }

  function drawHand(side, pose, points, restWeight) {
    const [x, y, angle, sx, sy] = pose;
    const count = points.length / 2;
    const point = index => {
      const start = ((index + count) % count) * 2;
      return [points[start], points[start + 1]];
    };
    let path = `M${point(0).join(' ')}`;
    for (let index = 0; index < count; index++) {
      const [px, py] = point(index - 1);
      const [ax, ay] = point(index);
      const [bx, by] = point(index + 1);
      const [nx, ny] = point(index + 2);
      const round = .13;
      path += ` C${ax + (bx - px) * round} ${ay + (by - py) * round} ${bx - (nx - ax) * round} ${by - (ny - ay) * round} ${bx} ${by}`;
    }
    set(`${side}-fingers`, 'd', `${path}Z`);
    place(`${side}-hand-gesture`, x, y, angle, sx, sy);
    opacity(`${side}-hand-gesture`, 1 - restWeight);
    opacity(`${side}-hand-rest`, restWeight);
  }

  function drawPaint(body, head, leg, left, right) {
    linear('torso-color', 0, body[0], 0, body[1]);
    linear('torso-contour', body[2], 0, body[3], 0);
    radial('shoulder-light', ...body.slice(4, 8), 22);
    radial('belly-gold', ...body.slice(8, 12));
    linear('belly-color', 0, body[12], 0, body[13]);
    radial('belly-light', ...body.slice(14, 18), -16);
    linear('hip-fade', 0, body[18], 0, body[19]);
    set('floor-shadow', 'cx', body[20]);

    linear('head-color', ...head.slice(0, 4));
    radial('crown-light', ...head.slice(4, 8));
    radial('throat-shade', ...head.slice(8, 12), 21);
    linear('head-fade', 0, head[12], 0, head[13]);

    linear('left-leg-color', leg[0], 0, leg[1], 0);
    linear('right-leg-color', leg[2], 0, leg[3], 0);
    linear('leg-depth', 0, leg[4], 0, leg[5]);
    linear('left-arm-color', ...left);
    linear('right-arm-color', ...right);
  }

  function render(t) {
    const duration = 5540;
    const time = Number.isFinite(t) ? ((t % duration) + duration) % duration : 0;
    let index = 0;
    while (index + 1 < poses.length && time >= poses[index + 1].time) {
      index++;
    }
    const from = poses[index];
    const to = poses[index + 1] || from;
    const progress = from === to ? 0 : (time - from.time) / (to.time - from.time);
    const eased = .4 * progress + .6 * progress * progress * (3 - 2 * progress);
    const sample = name => mix(from[name], to[name], eased);

    for (const [name, id] of Object.entries(outlines)) {
      const [x, y, ...curves] = sample(name);
      set(id, 'd', `M${x} ${y} C${curves.join(' ')}Z`);
    }
    drawPaint(sample('bodyPaint'), sample('headPaint'), sample('legPaint'),
      sample('leftPaint'), sample('rightPaint'));

    drawEye('left', sample('leftEye'));
    drawEye('right', sample('rightEye'));
    const [nx, ny, nsx, nsy, noseAngle, noseVisibility] = sample('nose');
    place('nose', nx, ny, noseAngle, nsx, nsy);
    opacity('nose', noseVisibility);
    drawMouth(sample('mouth'));

    const restWeight = Math.max(0, 1 - time / 135);
    const handPoints = side => mix(fingers[from.handShapes[side]], fingers[to.handShapes[side]], eased);
    drawHand('left', sample('leftHand'), handPoints(0), restWeight);
    drawHand('right', sample('rightHand'), handPoints(1), restWeight);

    const [leftFront, rightFront, leftShadow, rightShadow, leftLight, rightLight, rightVisibility] = sample('layering');
    opacity('left-arm-front', leftFront);
    opacity('right-arm-front', rightFront);
    opacity('left-arm-shadow', leftShadow);
    opacity('right-arm-shadow', rightShadow);
    opacity('left-arm-light', leftLight);
    opacity('right-arm-light', rightLight);
    opacity('arm-screen-right', rightVisibility);
  }

  window.nwb = { render };
  render(0);
</script>
